title: Demo-ready optional external application setup, version 1
description: No setup file is required for the four owned demos. Patriots and Tokens and Credits are optional external applications with optional azd environment names. Never add credentials, connection strings, or tokens.

version.description: Setup file contract version. Only version 1 is supported.

repositories.description: Every identity is optional. Legacy bundled identity entries cannot redirect deployment outside this repository.

defra.description: Legacy key. Only this checkout's src/PublicSectorAgentDemos.Demo2.Act path is accepted. Its environment comes from the presentation base.

assuranceBoard.description: Legacy key. Only this checkout's src/PublicSectorAgentDemos.Demo3.Coordinate path is accepted. Its environment comes from the presentation base.

patriots.description: Optional external azure-ai-mgs-patriots checkout. Startup reuses any existing local azd environment. It creates and deploys an environment only when none exists.

tokensAndCredits.description: Optional external tokens-and-credits checkout. Startup reuses any existing local azd environment. It creates and deploys an environment only when none exists.

path.description: Absolute path to the external Git repository working tree.

azdEnvironment.description: Optional azd environment name. If local environments exist, this name must select one. If none exist, startup creates this name instead of the presentation-base default.
